titulo: I will do, I will be able, I will leave
intro: Twelve very common verbs change their stem in the future, and after «si» the future is not used.
p.haré.consejo: «Hacer» loses «ce»: «har-». It is «haré», never «haceré». The «h» is silent.
p.tendré.consejo: «Tener» gains a «d»: «tendr-». The same rule works for «venir»: «vendré».
p.vendré.consejo: It is written with «v» and sounds «b». It is «venir» plus a «d»: «vendr-».
p.pondré.consejo: «Poner» gains a «d»: «pondr-». The same in «supondré» and «propondré».
p.sabré.consejo: «Saber» loses a vowel: «sabr-». It is written with «b» and sounds the same as with «v».
p.querré.consejo: «Querer» loses a vowel: «querr-». The double «rr» sounds strong.
p.habrá.consejo: In this sense it is always singular: «habrá muchos cambios». It is the future of «hay».
p.dentro de.glosa: in (a period of time from now)
p.dentro de.consejo: It counts time from now: «dentro de dos años» is today plus two years.
p.algún día.consejo: «Algún» is «alguno» shortened before a masculine singular noun.
p.estoy seguro de que.consejo: Between «seguro» and «que» goes «de». If you are a woman speaking, «estoy segura de que».
p.ahorrar.consejo: The «h» is silent and the «rr» sounds strong: «a-o-RRAR».
b1.texto:
The future is used to **predict** (**Mañana lloverá**), to **promise** (**Te llamaré**) and to talk about what **will happen**. Twelve very common verbs change their stem, but the endings are the usual ones.

For a plan that is already decided, **ir a + infinitive** is very common: **Voy a comprar** un coche.

With **dentro de** you count time from now: **dentro de dos años**.

And be careful with **si**: a real condition takes the present, not the future.
b2.f0.texto: What will you do in five years?
b2.f1.texto: I'll have another job and I'll go out less.
b2.f2.texto: If I save money, I'll be able to buy a small house.
b2.f3.texto: I'm sure there will be a lot of changes.
b2.f4.texto: Some day I'll tell you my plans.
b2.f5.texto: Will you tell them to me soon?
b2.f6.texto: I'll want to think about it calmly.
b2.f7.texto: If you like, I'll come with you to the coast.
b4.texto:
The endings are the same for every verb: **-é, -ás, -á, -emos, -éis, -án**. What changes is the stem:

- They lose a vowel: poder → **podr**é, saber → **sabr**é, querer → **querr**é, haber → **habr**á, caber → **cabr**é.
- They gain a **d**: tener → **tendr**é, venir → **vendr**é, poner → **pondr**é, salir → **saldr**é, valer → **valdr**é.
- They shorten: hacer → **har**é, decir → **dir**é.

With **si** + present the condition is real: **Si ahorro**, **podré** comprar una casa. After **si** the future is not used.
b4.e0.texto: Tomorrow I'll make an apple pie.
b4.e1.texto: My parents will come on Sunday.
b4.e2.texto: If you have time, we'll go out for dinner.
b5.titulo: A letter for ten years from now
b5.f0.texto: Marta writes a letter in the attic with a blue pen.
b5.f1.texto: The golden dust floats around the lamp like a small mist.
b5.f2.texto: The letter begins with a question for the Marta of the future.
b5.f3.texto: Her letters lean to the right like leaves in the wind.
b5.f4.texto: A distant clock strikes six in the evening.
b5.f5.texto: Marta promises that in ten years she will have a house with big windows.
b5.f6.texto: She writes that she will go out running every morning by the river.
b5.f7.texto: She notes down that she will put yellow flowers in every window.
b5.f8.texto: Her hand stops for a second above the white paper.
b5.f9.texto: Marta signs the letter in a firm hand and keeps it in a wooden box.
b6.o1.refuerzo: No: the irregular stem is «har-», not «hacer-».
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Hago» is the present, not the future.
b6.pregunta: What is the future of «hacer» with «yo»?
b7.o0.refuerzo: The stem is not «hay-»: it comes from «haber».
b7.o1.refuerzo: Correct: «haber» loses a vowel and becomes «habr-».
b7.o2.refuerzo: In this sense the verb is not made plural: «habrá muchos».
b8.frase: Algún día te diré mis planes
b8.traduccion: Some day I'll tell you my plans
b9.o0.refuerzo: After «si» the future is not used in a real condition.
b9.o1.refuerzo: The conditional does not go after «si» here either.
b9.pregunta: It is a real condition. Which tense follows «si»?
b10.o1.refuerzo: «Hacer» does not gain a «d»: it shortens, «haré».
b10.pregunta: Which verb gains a «d» in the future?
b12.o0.refuerzo: No: «venir» changes its stem and it is not «venir-».
b12.o1.refuerzo: Yes: «venir» gains a «d», «vendr-», plus the ending «-án».
b12.o2.refuerzo: «Vienen» is the present. For the future you need «vendrán».
b12.pregunta: Your parents arrive on Sunday. Which verb is missing?
p.harás.consejo: Future of «hacer» with «tú»: stem «har-» plus «-ás». The accent mark falls on the last syllable.
p.ahorro.consejo: Careful: «ahorro» is also a noun, «el ahorro» (saving). The «h» is silent.
p.cambios.consejo: It is the plural of «el cambio». «Un cambio» can also be small change in a shop.
p.planes.consejo: It is the plural of «el plan». The singular ends in -n, so the plural adds -es.
p.dirás.consejo: Future of «decir» with «tú»: stem «dir-» plus «-ás». It is «dirás», not «decirás».
p.pensarlo.consejo: It is «pensar» + «lo»: the pronoun joins the infinitive. «Lo» stands for «eso».
p.vendrán.consejo: Future of «venir» with «ellos»: stem «vendr-» plus «-án». The «v» sounds like «b».
p.saldremos.consejo: Future of «salir» with «nosotros»: stem «saldr-» plus «-emos». «Salir» gains a «d».
p.desván.consejo: It is masculine: «el desván». The plural drops the accent mark: «los desvanes».
p.pluma.consejo: It is feminine: «la pluma». It also means a bird's feather.
p.polvo.consejo: It is masculine: «el polvo». The «v» sounds like «b».
p.flota.consejo: It comes from «flotar», a regular verb. Careful: «la flota» is also a fleet of ships.
p.inclinan.consejo: In «se inclinan» the «se» makes the verb reflexive: they lean by themselves.
p.lejano.consejo: It comes from «lejos». It changes with gender: «lejano», «lejana». The «j» sounds like «h».
p.promete.consejo: It comes from «prometer», a regular verb. After «prometer que» comes a future: «promete que vendrá».
p.saldrá.consejo: Future of «salir» with «ella»: stem «saldr-» plus «-á». The accent mark is on the last syllable.
p.pondrá.consejo: Future of «poner» with «ella»: stem «pondr-» plus «-á». «Poner» gains a «d».
p.segundo.consejo: It is masculine: «un segundo». It is also an ordinal: «el segundo día».
p.iré.consejo: Future of «ir»: it is regular, «ir» + «é». The accent mark is on the «é».
